description.en: GLM Coding Plan and ZCode Start Plan as separate provider entries. Switch plans on one account to route its chat, models and quota through the selected product.
description.zh: 将 GLM Coding Plan 与 ZCode Start Plan 作为两个供应商提供；在同一账号上切换套餐后，聊天、模型和额度均使用所选套餐。

description.en: Authorize your Zhipu BigModel account in the browser; sign-in finishes automatically — no callback URL to copy.
description.zh: 在浏览器登录智谱 BigModel 完成授权，页面会自动检测并收尾，无需复制任何地址。

help.en: Check for claimable activities every 10 minutes and claim them automatically. Activities that require security verification cannot be claimed automatically.
help.zh: 每 10 分钟检查一次可领取的活动并自动领取；需要安全验证的活动无法自动领取。
